3.name: Dazzling Footwork (College of Dance)
3.description: Calculate unarmored AC as 10 + DEX + CHA modifiers and make an Unarmed Strike using your Bardic Inspiration die when expending Bardic Inspiration.

6.name: Inspiring Movement & Tandem Footwork (College of Dance)
6.description: Expend Bardic Inspiration as a Reaction when an enemy moves within 5 feet to move and let an ally move, and add your Bardic Inspiration die to Initiative for yourself and nearby allies.

14.name: Leading Evasion (College of Dance)
14.description: Take no damage on a successful DEX save and half damage on a failure, and share that Evasion benefit with allies within 5 feet who aren't Incapacitated.

dazzling_footwork.name: Agile Strikes
dazzling_footwork.hint: Unarmed Strike damage die when expending Bardic Inspiration (uses DEX + Bardic Inspiration die).

3.name: Beguiling Magic & Mantle of Inspiration (College of Glamour)
3.description: Always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared, and spend Bardic Inspiration as a Bonus Action to grant allies Temporary HP and reaction movement.

6.name: Mantle of Majesty (College of Glamour)
6.description: Always have Command prepared and cast it as a Bonus Action every turn for 1 minute without expending a spell slot (auto-failing Charmed foes).

14.name: Unbreakable Majesty (College of Glamour)
14.description: As a Bonus Action, force creatures attacking you for the next minute to pass a CHA save or miss entirely on the first attack each turn.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies & Cutting Words (College of Lore)
3.description: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice, and spend Bardic Inspiration as a Reaction to subtract from an enemy's attack roll, ability check, or damage.

6.name: Magical Discoveries (College of Lore)
6.description: Learn and always have prepared two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists of a level for which you have spell slots.

14.name: Peerless Skill (College of Lore)
14.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, expend a Bardic Inspiration die and add it to the roll without expending the die if it still fails.

3.name: Combat Inspiration & Martial Training (College of Valor)
3.description: Gain proficiency with Medium Armor, Shields, and Martial Weapons, use weapons as Spellcasting Focuses, and empower allies' damage or AC with Bardic Inspiration.

6.name: Extra Attack (College of Valor)
6.description: Attack twice when taking the Attack action, and optionally replace one of those attacks with a casting of one of your cantrips.

14.name: Battle Magic (College of Valor)
14.description: After casting a spell that has a casting time of an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
